answer: Polo club membership with chukka participation history is the check: chukkas played under one club for years. A farm faking 124 aliases needs 124 separate participation histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The relic check runs in the open: 124 fakes pay the full price 124 times, one honest agent pays once, and the onyx trail in the ledger makes the marble cost visible to everyone.
